summary: Aircraft stands 1 to 3 out of use at EGVN, and runway stop bars support only Category I operations.
text:
ACFT STANDS 1-3 NOT IN USE. ILLUMINATED STAND NUMBERS AND AGNIS 
NOT IN USE. STANDS IDENTIFIED BY PAINTED GROUND NUMBERS AND 
DIRECTIONAL ARROWS. ALL AIRCRAFT STOP POSITIONS ARE INDICATED BY 
MARSHALLERS. RWY STOP BARS SUPPORT CAT I OPS ONLY. CAT II/III OPS 
NOT AVBL.
